title: Sphinx Cat Artist Painting
description: A hairless sphinx cat with purple markings, glasses, and multiple eyes wears a paint-splattered apron while sitting on a black platform and drawing in a large spiral notebook with a yellow pencil. The surreal scene is filled with floating cartoon eyeballs, bones, tentacles, dripping colorful paint, and a large yellow eye in a swirling vortex background.
prompt: A hairless sphinx cat with purple spots and multiple eyes, wearing round glasses and a paint-splattered apron, sits on a black platform drawing in a large spiral notebook with a pencil. Surreal dark background with swirling green vortex, giant yellow eye, floating cartoon eyeballs with teeth, red bones, blue tentacles, and colorful dripping paint splatters, vibrant psychedelic style with high contrast and detailed textures
